name: Offset Compression
definition: A compression technique for tree offsets that exploits the fact that the offset from a node to its first child is always +1, allowing it to be stored implicitly, and that offsets are typically small in lower tree levels due to depth-first assignment.
summary: Offset Compression reduces sparse voxel tree memory by implicitly storing the first child offset and using level-adaptive, byte-aligned bit-packing for sibling offsets to optimize GPU texture lookups.
